key_architectural_breakthroughs: 1. Periodic Macroblock Pruning: Pruning entire 4-layer macroblocks preserves the 3:1 SSM-to-Attention ratio and maintains recurrent dynamic stability.
2. Residual Return Preservation: ffn_down must remain 100% dense ternary PTQ1_0; sparse quantization of ffn_down destroys the skip connection.
3. Least-Squares Scale Optimization: Avoiding artificial scale multipliers (like energy_mult = sqrt(nz/64)) prevents activation variance explosion over deep layers.
4. PRISM Recurrent Layer Map Injection: Explicit injection of qwen35.attention.recurrent_layers allows arbitrary layer counts while maintaining proper KV-cache allocation.
